title: Titan Pro 15K Banana Ice Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Banana Ice serves soft, ripe Banana sweetness lifted by a brisk, icy exhale. The flavour stays clear and steady thanks to a mesh-coil pod and a refill system that keeps the coil consistently saturated. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and a 10ml refill container for the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh coil ensures precise vapour output, while the refill system maintains coil saturation for steady performance. Explore more Titan Pro 15K refill pods and discover other flavours you’ll love from the full Titan Pro pods range . How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
